data.name: San Diego Tours: Highlights Tour (Daily)
data.description:
Begin in the historic Gaslamp Quarter, known for its Victorian-era architecture and vibrant nightlife. Cruise past Petco Park and the modern skyline before heading to Balboa Park, home to over 16 museums, lush gardens, and the world-famous San Diego Zoo.

Cross the scenic Coronado Bridge to explore the charming island of Coronado, where you’ll admire the iconic Hotel del Coronado and white-sand beaches. Then, journey north along the coast to the upscale seaside village of La Jolla, where you’ll spot sea lions basking on the rocks and stop at the panoramic Mt. Soledad National Veterans Memorial, offering sweeping 360° views of the Pacific Ocean, San Diego skyline, and even Mexico on clear days.
data.itinerary:
2:00 PM – Pick-Up at Guest Location
Start your personalized tour with your private driver-guide.

2:15 PM – Gaslamp Quarter
Explore the historic Victorian architecture and vibrant streets.

2:45 PM – Petco Park & Downtown Skyline
Drive through the modern heart of San Diego.

3:00 PM – Balboa Park
Enjoy gardens, museums, and iconic landmarks.

4:00 PM – Coronado Island
Cross the Coronado Bridge, visit Hotel del Coronado, and stroll the beaches.

5:00 PM – La Jolla & Mt. Soledad Viewpoint
Watch sea lions and take in panoramic views of San Diego and beyond.

6:00 PM – Return to Pick-Up Location

data.booking_notes:
Thank you for booking the San Diego Highlights Private Tour with us! We’re excited to show you the best of America’s Finest City.

Your private driver-guide will pick you up at the agreed location and time. Please be ready a few minutes before the scheduled pick-up.

The tour includes stops at iconic locations with opportunities for photos and exploration.

Bottled water and light snacks are provided.

Please bring comfortable walking shoes, a camera, and layered clothing to prepare for changing weather.

Gratuities and meals are not included.

If you have any special requests or questions before your tour, feel free to contact us.

We recommend arriving on time to fully enjoy your personalized experience.

We look forward to making your San Diego visit memorable!
